name: Better Call Claude
tagline: Free help working out what a legal problem actually is
description: Most people meeting a legal problem for the first time do not know what kind of problem it is or who deals with it. This is an open, no-cost place to start: it lays out the terrain in plain language, points you at the material on bettercallclaude.org, and keeps its reading current. It orients you; it is not a lawyer.
author: Robauto
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
